title: Nicolai Hartmann — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Nicolai Hartmann — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. He is regarded as a key representative of critical realism and as one of the most important twentieth-century metaphysicians. His early work in the philosophy of biology has been cited in modern discussions of genomics and cloning.
